_comment: Slice manifest: which part of the ontology the extractor may use.
ontology_file: the OWL file in ontology/ to load (RDF/XML, Turtle or OWL/XML). If missing, the first other .owl/.rdf/.ttl file is used, then the starter ontology.

entity_groups: classes are referenced by rdfs:label (case-insensitive) or full IRI. Every root found is used together with all its subclasses; roots that do not exist are reported as warnings, so alternatives can be listed.
The allowed labels become enums in Claude's output schema. Anything that fits none of them comes back as OTHER plus a proposed class label; those proposals end up in data/graph/ontology_gaps.csv.

relations: 'ontology_property' lists candidate object-property labels/IRIs; if none is found the relation is still extracted but flagged as an ontology gap. pass=implicit: produced by the structure of passes 1-2; pass=relations: offered to Claude in pass 3.

material.description: Chemical identity / phase of matter (e.g. c-Si, a-Si:H, SiNx, a dopant element, a precursor gas).

sample.description: A specific physical specimen made or measured in this paper (wafer, film, stack, device), identified by its process history.

process.description: Steps that create or modify a sample (deposition, annealing, doping, etching, cleaning, growth, simulation).

process_attribute.description: Kinds of process parameters (temperature, pressure, duration, gas flow, power, atmosphere...).

property.description: Measured or computed properties, including device performance metrics.

application.description: Intended application of a material or device.

other.description: Other entities worth keeping (charge carriers, data products...).

relations.name: has_input
relations.definition: A process step consumes or modifies this sample/material.

relations.name: has_output
relations.definition: A process step produces this sample.

relations.name: precedes
relations.definition: One process step happens before another in the same sample's history.

relations.name: has_parameter
relations.definition: A process step is run with this parameter value.

relations.name: measured_on
relations.definition: A measurement was performed on this sample.

relations.name: has_property_value
relations.definition: A sample has a reported value of a property.

relations.name: part_of
relations.definition: A layer/component is physically part of a larger sample or device (e.g. a SiNx layer is part of a passivation stack).

relations.name: composed_of
relations.definition: A sample is made of / contains this material (e.g. a film composed of a-Si:H, a wafer doped with boron).

relations.name: intended_for
relations.definition: The paper states the material or device is developed or used for this application.

relations.name: influences
relations.definition: The paper reports that changing a process parameter or step changes a property (give the trend).

relations.name: derived_from
relations.definition: A sample was made from another sample (e.g. an annealed film derived from the as-deposited film).

relations.name: compared_with
relations.definition: The paper explicitly compares two samples, materials or processes (no superiority implied).
